modules.title: 订单和库存怎样一起成功或一起撤销？
这个案例怎样从失败变成可验收结果

items.title: 问题与关键机制
items.text: 创建订单和扣减库存分开处理时，扣库存失败可能留下半成品订单；把这两步放进同一个事务后，只要有一步失败，就会回滚已经写入的订单与库存修改。

items.title: 怎样观察改善
items.text: 订单与库存操作全部成功后才一起提交。成功时返回订单号，失败时返回具体原因，不能把未完成的订单显示成成功。

items.title: 诊所预约也需要事务
items.text: 新增预约记录与占用医生时段应放进同一个事务；如果时段已被占用就一起回滚，不能留下没有时段的预约。

modules.title: 仍不保证什么
modules.text: 事务通常只保护同一个数据库中的这组操作；外部支付、邮件通知和其他服务不会随数据库事务自动回滚，需要单独设计状态或补偿流程。

lessonPractice.title: 库存扣减失败，但页面已经显示下单成功。怎样修复？

options.label: 把创建订单和扣减库存放进同一事务，失败就回滚并返回失败
options.feedback: 对。两次数据库修改共享同一个提交边界，扣库存失败时不会留下未完成的订单。

options.label: 先保存订单，库存失败后再另写一条取消订单记录
options.feedback: 这仍然是两次独立写入，在补写取消记录期间可能暴露错误状态，不能提供同一个提交边界。

options.label: 订单写入成功就显示成功，库存失败只记录日志供之后处理
options.feedback: 这样页面会把未完成的订单当作成功显示给用户，而且仅记录日志并不能撤销已经写入的订单。

en.title: Inventory deduction fails, but the page already reports success. How should the flow be fixed?

options.label: Put order creation and inventory deduction in one transaction; roll back and return a failure if needed
options.feedback: Correct. Both database changes share the same commit boundary, so a failed deduction will not leave an incomplete order behind.

options.label: Save the order first, then write a cancellation record if inventory fails
options.feedback: These are still separate writes. Writing a cancellation record later can briefly expose an incorrect state and does not provide a shared commit boundary.

options.label: Show success after the order write and leave the inventory failure in logs
options.feedback: The page would show an incomplete order as successful to the user, and logging the error does not undo the database change.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请检查下单流程，把创建订单和扣减库存放进同一个数据库事务。模拟扣库存失败，确认订单记录和库存都没有留下部分改动；全部成功时再提交并返回订单号。不要假设外部支付或邮件能被这个事务自动回滚。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Inspect the checkout flow and put order creation and inventory deduction in the same database transaction. Simulate an inventory deduction failure and verify that neither an order record nor partial inventory changes remain. Commit and return the order ID only when both succeed. Do not assume external payments or emails will roll back automatically.

learning.assumes: You know that an order and inventory can be stored as separate database records.
learning.outcome: You can decide which database changes belong in one transaction and verify that a failure does not leave a partial update.

modules.title: How can an order and inventory succeed or roll back together?
How the case moves from failure to a verifiable result

items.title: Problem and key mechanism
items.text: When order creation and inventory deduction are handled separately, a stock failure can leave an incomplete order behind. Putting both in the same transaction ensures that if either step fails, all order and inventory changes are rolled back.

items.title: How to observe the improvement
items.text: Commit the order and inventory changes together only after both succeed. Return the order ID on success, and return a specific reason on failure instead of presenting partial work as success.

items.title: Clinic booking also needs a transaction
items.text: Creating an appointment record and reserving the doctor's time slot belong in the same transaction. If the slot is unavailable, both roll back so no appointment is left without a slot.

modules.title: What this still does not guarantee
modules.text: A transaction usually protects operations within the same database. External payments, emails, and other services do not roll back automatically and need separate status tracking or compensation design.

distinctions.label: Atomicity
distinctions.text: {c:atomicity} is a core ACID property guaranteeing all-or-nothing execution; a {c:transaction} is the full database boundary providing this guarantee.

distinctions.label: Database Write
distinctions.text: A {c:database-write} persists records; a {c:transaction} establishes the commit and rollback boundary for multi-step writes.
